description: Opus FF FF-parity-harness (reduced from runs/parity-20260927 gardevoir-vs-psy-cona random game 2, decision 3): the Champions mod's Encore replaces the target's queued action (`queue.changeAction`), so an encored Protect moves at +4. Setup turn: everyone Protects (stall counters 3). Decision: Snorlax Protects (1/3), Prankster Sableye Encores Armarouge, whose Dark Pulse becomes Protect and now goes before the faster Sneasler (Close Combat into Ghost Sableye: immune); with Sneasler still to move, `willAct()` holds and Armarouge's Protect succeeds with 1/3 (stall 3 -> 9). The base game's `onOverrideAction` would keep priority 0: Sneasler first, Armarouge last, and its Protect always fails. Speeds 140 / 95 / 70 / 50: no ties.
